submissions.market_view: Indexes slipped Wednesday (S&P 500 -0.2%, Dow -0.7%) as rising Treasury yields hit industrials and homebuilders, while AI-infrastructure and power names stayed bid. Samsung's record but roughly in-line Q3 profit and Korea's weak open make memory a show-me trade Thursday; stock-specific after-hours news (Wolfspeed) should drive the biggest moves.
lessons: Small-cap after-hours gaps often fade by mid-morning (NEOG opened well below its AH price and hit the stop in minutes), so on gap names set the target near the likely opening print and keep stops just under the reference close.
Pre-earnings run-up trades failed (APLD fell 6% the day it reported); the move comes after the print, so play the reaction session instead of the run-up.
Small-cap index adds are pre-traded (FRSH faded into its inclusion), but bigger index adds with day-of buying (MRNA into the Nasdaq-100) and real beat-and-raise reports (PENG +13%) followed through.

positions.thesis: TSMC's Q3 (press release, Oct 15) beat its own guide with $46.72B revenue (+41% y/y in USD) and a 66.4% gross margin, and it guided Q4 to $52.3-54.3B on the 2nm ramp. The ADR still fell in the AI-hardware rotation to 422.25, about 13% under its 20-day high, so this is a pullback entry after beat-and-raise.
positions.main_risk: The AI-hardware selloff (worries about debt-funded capex) could deepen. The thesis is invalidated by a guidance cut or a sustained break below the ~407 20-day low; the stop at 385 is ~2.9x its 12.6 ATR.

last_review.reason: Fell 4.5% to 412.35 with the chip index after Lam's supply-chain comment, not on TSMC news, and its Oct 15 beat-and-raise quarter still stands; the 385 stop is about 2x its 3.3% daily range below.

positions.thesis: Intuit agreed on Oct 15 to buy AI-native revenue platform Sequence to extend Intuit Enterprise Suite into mid-market ERP (Intuit IR/Business Wire, Oct 15), and the stock rose ~6% to 330.17 as money rotated into software (CNBC, Oct 15). It is still ~11% under its 3-month high near 373, leaving room for a multi-session recovery if the rotation holds.
positions.main_risk: The deal is small with undisclosed terms, so the move depends on the software rotation; the thesis is invalidated if the rotation reverses and INTU gives back Thursday's gain to below ~318 (stop at 312 is ~1.6x its 11.4 ATR).

last_review.reason: Lagged Monday's tech bounce (+0.1% to 325.62) but held above the 312 stop at a 317.93 low, and the company-specific Sequence deal (Intuit IR, Oct 15) and Intuit Intelligence global rollout (Oct 19 coverage) are intact with three sessions left.

positions.thesis: SpaceX's Oct 8-9, 2026 deal to buy up to 14 MHz of 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management gives Starlink Mobile 'the outline of a real network' (Evercore), and a new terrestrial carrier needs tower leases; Crown Castle jumped 15.6% Friday on ~14M shares (nearly 4x average) to a 3-month high while carriers sold off. Reference close 79.64, 20-day avg volume ~3.8M.
positions.catalyst_time: 2026-10-09 deal reaction; analyst tower-lease notes 2026-10-12 to 10-14
positions.main_risk: Any SpaceX build-out takes years (JPMorgan sees limited near-term impact), and a weaker carrier base is a risk to tower tenants; invalidated if CCI gives back half of Friday's gain (below ~74) or SpaceX signals a satellite-only plan.

positions.thesis: Moderna rose 14.2% to a 52-week high on Oct 9, 2026 as it rejoined the Nasdaq-100 and reports said an NIH-backed public-private cancer-vaccine program is planned for December, where its Merck-partnered Phase 3 melanoma vaccine is the lead mRNA asset; it closed at the day's high and held 225.47 after hours. Reference close 225.00, 20-day avg volume ~17M.
positions.main_risk: Index buying is finished, the stock is ~60% off its 20-day low, and a policy report can be walked back; invalidated if the NIH program is denied or it breaks below 213.

positions.thesis: Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston said Oct 9, 2026 its optical components are sold out through early 2029 and it can meet only ~30% of demand for some products next year, implying pricing power and estimate raises; the stock rose 5.2% to a record close with TSMC results Thursday as a further AI read. Reference close 1103.35, 20-day avg volume ~4.7M.
positions.main_risk: Already up ~33% off its 20-day low and AI hardware has been choppy; comments are not new guidance. Invalidated if it loses Friday's 1,048-1,060 area.

positions.catalyst_time: 2026-10-09 approval; launch and analyst notes over the next sessions
positions.main_risk: A large, slow stock where the approval was expected, so it may already be priced in; invalidated by a close back below 40.

positions.thesis: Humana's Oct 9, 2026 8-K says 95% of its Medicare Advantage members are in 4+ star plans for 2027 (vs 20% for 2026), worth about $160 per member per month in Stars revenue versus its $115 goal, and it affirmed FY26 adjusted EPS of at least $9.00; the stock rose 11.6% to its highest close since Jan 2024 and analysts have yet to fully reprice 2028 earnings. positions.main_risk: Humana says part of the 2028 benefit is one-time, and UNH reports Tuesday before the open and can swing the group; invalidated if it loses Friday's 428 low.

positions.thesis: Quantum-Si reported on Oct 8, 2026 (8-K) detection of 19 amino acids on its Proteus platform, with all 20 targeted by year-end and launch planned for Q2 2027; the stock rose 25% Friday on 40.7M shares (5x average) and held 1.54 after hours. positions.main_risk: Pre-revenue, retail-heavy, already about double its 20-day low, and could sell shares into strength; invalidated by a share offering or a red open below 1.50.

positions.thesis: SVC confirmed on Oct 9, 2026 an unsolicited $2.0B all-cash proposal from TKO Hotels for its 93-hotel portfolio, which TKO says exceeds SVC's whole market cap (~$0.93B); the stock rose 15% and traded 7.54 after hours, and any board engagement could push it toward the 20-day high near 7.94 and beyond.
